nodes.description: Ownership address stored in OwnableData, set to msg.sender at construction and mutated by transferOwnership/claimOwnership.
Token address (Sins) controlled only by the owner through setSinsAddress and used as the token side of Uniswap liquidity.
Address nominated for ownership; claimed by pendingOwner via claimOwnership.
Sets owner = msg.sender and emits OwnershipTransferred(0, msg.sender).
onlyOwner function that directly or via pendingOwner transfers ownership; guarded by onlyOwner modifier.
Allows the pendingOwner to claim ownership; requires msg.sender == pendingOwner.
Sets the Sins token address; only callable by owner (checked with require(msg.sender == owner)).
Access-control modifier requiring msg.sender == owner.
Access-control modifier requiring msg.sender == Sins.
Empty constructor of taxDistributor.
Payable receive hook accepting ether into the distributor contract.
Private function that approves tokens and calls UniswapV2Router02.addLiquidity with block.timestamp as deadline.
onlySins external function that transfers DAI to buyback/marketing wallets and adds liquidity.
Caller address used for ownership checks in Ownable and the onlySins modifier.
Miner-influenced timestamp passed as the Uniswap deadline.
External call to IUniswapV2Router02.addLiquidity with slippage set to 0 and deadline block.timestamp.
External IERC20(dai).transfer(buybackWallet, daiForBuyback) performed before other state-changing work.
External IERC20(dai).transfer(marketingWallet, balanceOf(address(this))) sending the whole remaining balance.
External IERC20 approve calls granting the router unlimited allowance over Sins and DAI amounts.
Parameter newOwner of transferOwnership.
Parameter direct selecting immediate vs pending ownership transfer.
Parameter renounce allowing zero-address owner when transferring directly.
Parameter _sins, the new Sins token address.
Local copy of pendingOwner used for the caller check and later assignment to owner.
Parameter urv2, the Uniswap V2 router address.
Parameter dai, the DAI token address used for liquidity.
Parameter tokenAmount, the Sins amount approved and added as liquidity.
Parameter daiAmount, the DAI amount approved and added as liquidity.
Parameter liquidityTo, recipient of the minted LP tokens.
Local IUniswapV2Router02 instance created from the urv2 address.
Parameter urv2 of distribute, forwarded router address.
Parameter dai of distribute, token used for transfers and liquidity.
Parameter marketingWallet receiving the residual DAI balance.
Parameter daiForBuyback, DAI amount sent to the buyback wallet.
Parameter buybackWallet receiving daiForBuyback.
Parameter liquidityTokens, Sins amount forwarded to addLiquidity.
Parameter daiForLiquidity, DAI amount forwarded to addLiquidity.
Parameter liquidityTo of distribute, forwarded as LP token recipient.

edges.reason: onlyOwner validates msg.sender against owner, making the caller the access-control subject.
onlySins validates msg.sender against Sins, gating distribute.
claimOwnership requires msg.sender to equal the pending owner.
setSinsAddress requires msg.sender to be the owner before changing Sins.
The Ownable constructor assigns owner from msg.sender.
The onlyOwner modifier gates entry to transferOwnership.
The onlySins modifier gates entry to distribute.
claimOwnership reads pendingOwner into the local _pendingOwner.
claimOwnership writes the claimed address into owner.
claimOwnership clears pendingOwner after the claim.
transferOwnership with direct=true overwrites owner.
transferOwnership sets or clears pendingOwner depending on the direct flag.
setSinsAddress assigns the new token address to Sins, which drives all distribution logic.
Constructor initialises owner to the deployer.
block.timestamp is passed directly as the Uniswap deadline, creating timestamp dependency.
addLiquidity makes an external router call with zero slippage protection that can re-enter or be manipulated.
addLiquidity performs external ERC20 approve calls on attacker-influenced token addresses.
distribute transfers DAI out via an externally supplied token contract before other effects complete.
distribute performs a second external ERC20 transfer of the full balance to an arbitrary marketing wallet.
distribute conditionally invokes the private addLiquidity helper.
newOwner is the destination of the ownership assignment.
direct selects the immediate versus pending ownership branch.
renounce relaxes the zero-address requirement in the direct branch.
_sins is the value written by setSinsAddress.
The caller-supplied _sins becomes the privileged Sins token address.
The _pendingOwner local is loaded and compared inside claimOwnership.
The local _pendingOwner is written into owner after the check.
urv2 feeds the router used by addLiquidity.
urv2 becomes the target address of the external Uniswap router call.
dai is the DAI token handled by addLiquidity.
dai is the token approved to the router.
tokenAmount is the Sins amount processed by addLiquidity.
tokenAmount is the approval amount granted to the router.
daiAmount is the DAI amount processed by addLiquidity.
daiAmount is the DAI approval amount granted to the router.
liquidityTo receives the LP tokens minted by addLiquidity.
liquidityTo is passed as the 'to' argument of the router call.
The local router instance is the object on which addLiquidity is invoked.
distribute's urv2 parameter is threaded through to the liquidity call.
distribute's dai parameter is the token used for all transfers.
dai is the token contract invoked for the buyback transfer.
dai is the token contract invoked for the marketing transfer and balance query.
marketingWallet is a distribution recipient.
marketingWallet is the 'to' argument of the residual balance transfer.
daiForBuyback controls the buyback transfer amount.
daiForBuyback is the amount argument of the buyback transfer.
buybackWallet is a distribution recipient.
buybackWallet is the 'to' argument of the buyback transfer.
liquidityTokens gates and parameterises the liquidity branch of distribute.
liquidityTokens is forwarded to addLiquidity as the token amount.
daiForLiquidity gates and parameterises the liquidity branch of distribute.
daiForLiquidity is forwarded to addLiquidity as the DAI amount.
liquidityTo selects the LP token recipient in distribute.
liquidityTo is forwarded to addLiquidity as the LP recipient.
